== Title ==
<span lang="ja">沈黙は金</span>. No uniqueness marker precedes the printed title.

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">2フォース消費して場の自分の側に配備する。どちらのプレイヤーもその場所にドロイドがいるロケーションには“リアクション”として移動してきたり、カードを配備することができない。「アクセス・リンク」（インタラプト）によってキャンセルされる。</span>

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">「すみません、船長。申し上げ……」</span>

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title''' — Silence Is Golden.

'''Lore''' — Excuse me, captain. I would like to say...

'''Game text''' — Use 2 Force to deploy on your side of the table. Neither player may move as a react to, or deploy cards to, a location where a droid is present. Canceled by Access Link (Interrupt).

== Comparison with the English printing ==
The Japanese names the canceling card Access Link (Interrupt), not Scomp Link Access. It separately forbids react movement and deploying cards to a droid location. Lore says 船長 (captain), not sir.<ref>[[:File:Hoth-D-silenceisgolden.gif|Original English face]], [[Silence Is Golden]].</ref>
